info.title: lurp : Roslyn-native semantic context engine for C#
info.description: Lurp — a Roslyn semantic map for .NET agents. Indexes a C# solution into SQLite via Roslyn and serves retrieval, semantic-diff, impact, and bounded context capsules to other software agents.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description:
Directory where index.db is stored. --solution= may
stand in for it when it points at a solution directory.
(LURP_OUTPUT_DIR / LURP_SOLUTION_PATH set these too.)

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Index a solution and store facts in the database.
List declarations in a document with line spans (--document=).
Full-text search over source and symbols.
Resolve an indexed declaration by file and line.
Show semantic changes between two snapshots.
List the symbols a changed symbol can reach, each with a witness path.
Assemble a context capsule for a symbol.
Show the current database status.
Show step-by-step timing data for a snapshot.
Attach a user-authored annotation to a symbol.
List compiler diagnostics captured at index time (--document=, --project=, --severity=, --id=).
Literal/exact-text search over source content with line numbers (--query=).
Run an MCP server over the index (stdio).
